龙国篇第十七章神龙市
艾米矗立在昏黄的灯光下，她的身影被拉长，投射出一种不容置疑的坚决，那双眼睛，宛如寒夜中最锋利的冰刃，穿透了周遭微弱的光芒，直刺向面前的艾露，又在叶恒那张紧绷的脸上来回逡巡，她的声音，低沉而冷酷，就像是深冬冰窖中艰难挤出的几个字，带着不容抗拒的寒意：“要不要杀了艾露？”
这句话一出，整个空间仿佛被一股无形的力量猛然冻结，连空气都凝固成了实质，沉重得让人窒息。
烛光摇曳，投下斑驳的影子，却更添了几分阴森与不安，每个人的呼吸都变得异常艰难，仿佛连空气中的氧气也被这句话剥夺，只剩下压抑与恐惧在无声蔓延。
叶恒没有立刻回应，他的眼神在昏暗中闪烁，就像是夜空中最遥远的星辰，既明亮又充满未知，他的心跳在胸腔内狂跳，每一次撞击都像是战鼓擂响，震颤着他的每一寸神经，让他无法找到一丝平静，他下意识地握紧了拳头，指节因用力而泛白，掌心中粗糙的皮质手套似乎成了他此刻唯一的依靠，传递着一种莫名的力量与安慰。
那一刻，时间仿佛凝固，叶恒的思绪在脑海中飞速旋转，每一个念头都如同利箭般穿梭，寻找着最佳的出路。
叶恒深知，这个问题的答案，不仅关乎艾露的生死，更牵动着他们所有人的命运走向，他闭上眼睛，深吸一口气，试图在这窒息的氛围中寻得一丝理智的缝隙。
短短的几秒沉默，在那狭小的空间里仿佛被无限拉长，成为了一场无尽的煎熬，终于，在经历了仿佛一个世纪般漫长的沉默后，叶恒呼出一气“我们不能这么做”
这句话，如同一声惊雷，在静谧的空间中炸响，震得每个人的耳膜嗡嗡作响。
“艾米姐，艾露，我们不能杀。”
艾米闻言，身形微微一震，眼中闪过一抹惊愕与困惑。
她凝视着叶恒，试图从那双深邃的眼眸中捕捉到一丝线索。
然而，叶恒的眼神犹如一片幽深莫测的潭水，波澜不惊，却让人无法触及那隐藏在水面下的真相。
“为何？”
艾米终是忍不住开口。
叶恒没有立即回答，他看了看艾露，然后，又缓缓地看向艾米“因为她是我们的线索，也是我们找到真相的关键，再加上，艾露是S级叛者，若能将她带回武神国对我们这一次的行动可记上不少功勋”
眼神中，闪烁着决然的光芒，那是一种智慧与计谋，艾米凝视着他，眼中初现一抹讶异，随即被深深的理解所取代，她轻轻颔首，无需多言，那份敬佩已悄然在她眼底生根，她深知，眼前的叶恒，已蜕变往昔那个举棋不定的少年模样，成长为一位怀抱坚定信念的男子汉。
艾米轻轻颔首，眼中闪烁着对叶恒忧虑的理解之光，他们深知，此行务必步步为营，丝毫的松懈都可能埋下祸根。
唯有如此，方能巧妙地利用艾露的身份，为自己的安全织就一张隐形的防护网，她点了点头，明白叶恒的意图，于是，为了确保万无一失，叶恒缓缓自空间戒指中取出一枚泛着幽光的锁神环，手法娴熟地将艾露体内汹涌澎湃的武神力缓缓封印，以此消除潜在的威胁。
随着艾露这一棘手难题的妥善解决，前路依旧布满未知的挑战与暗藏的凶险，但他们已整装待发，无畏前行。

迎着阳光渐渐照亮头顶，一行人悄然离开了龙爪牙市，他们的步伐坚定而迅速，仿佛有着无形的力量推动着他们向前，叶恒走在最前面，而艾露被封印了武神力，自然被安排在了队伍的中间，由两名队员严密看守，即便如此她的眼神中透露出一丝不甘和愤怒，但却无法挣脱锁神环的束缚。
队伍阳光下穿行，周围的景色在太阳的照耀下显得格外神秘而诡异，他们穿过了茂密的森林，翻越了险峻的山岭，终于来到了龙国更深处的神龙市。
神龙市是一座庞大的城市，高耸的建筑在阳光的掩映下显得更加宏伟壮观。
然而，这座城市却弥漫着一种压抑和沉重的气氛，仿佛有什么不为人知的秘密正隐藏在这座城市的深处。
神龙市是龙国的首都，也是曾经站在顶峰的都市，虽然以前的龙国统治着整个星球，但他们很爱人类，对待人类就像对待自己的子民一样。
在神龙市的中心，有一座高耸入云的巨大建筑，被称为“龙心塔”
塔身由一种名为“星辰石”
的稀有材料建成，每当夜幕降临，塔身便会散发出淡淡的光芒，宛如一颗璀璨的明珠镶嵌在城市的中心，即使已过去几百余年，但这座高台依旧屹立不倒在这个城市的中心，像是在诉说，龙国的伟大与神秘，此时，龙心塔的顶层，一名身着黑袍的中年男子正俯瞰着整个城市，他的眼神深邃而锐利，仿佛能洞穿一切虚幻，直视到城市的每一个角落。
“这座城市，曾经是我们龙国的骄傲。”
男子轻声自语，他的声音中充满了怀念和感慨，他伸出手，轻轻触摸着身边的星辰石，那冰冷的触感让他不禁陷入了回忆。
“曾经，我也是龙国神龙族的骄傲，是我太过于弱小没能守住龙国让魔龙族钻了空子，导致神龙族连续招到重创又因异能兽突然降临大陆，而不敌灭亡......”
“这里，曾是一片山清水秀的人间仙境，蜿蜒的小河清澈见底，宛如一条银色的丝带，在翠绿的群山间轻轻飘舞。
河水潺潺，轻抚着河岸上的鹅卵石，发出悦耳的响声，似乎在诉说着古老的故事。”
“我还记得，四周崇山峻岭层峦叠嶂，树木葱茏，苍翠欲滴。
山间的鸟儿欢快地歌唱，与远处偶尔传来的牧笛声交织成一幅美丽的音乐画卷，这里的空气带着大自然的清新和甜美，每吸一口，仿佛能洗净心中的尘埃。”
“然而，岁月如梭，时光荏苒；随着时间的推移，这片美丽的土地逐渐发生了改变，慢慢消失在了时间的长河中”
随着神秘人话语的落下，他轻轻地瞥了一眼叶恒等人，那深邃的目光如同夜空中的星辰，闪烁着令人捉摸不透的光芒，他的嘴角勾起一抹难以察觉的弧度，仿佛在嘲笑着他们的无知与渺小，嘴中微微念道；“不要认我失望”

Dragon Kingdom Chapter 17 Shenlong City
Amy stood under the dim light, her figure elongated, projecting an unquestionable determination. Her eyes, like the sharpest ice blades in the cold night, penetrated the weak light around her and pierced straight to Ai Lu in front of her. They wandered back and forth on Ye Heng's tense face. Her voice was low and cold, like a few words squeezed out of an ice cellar in the depth of winter, with an irresistible chill: "Do you want to kill Ai Lu?"
As soon as these words came out, the entire space seemed to be suddenly frozen by an invisible force, and even the air solidified into substance, making it suffocatingly heavy.
The candlelight swayed, casting mottled shadows, but it added a bit of gloom and uneasiness. Everyone's breathing became extremely difficult, as if even the oxygen in the air had been deprived of by these words, leaving only depression and fear spreading silently.
Ye Heng did not respond immediately. His eyes flickered in the dimness, like the most distant stars in the night sky, both bright and full of unknowns. His heart beat wildly in his chest, and every impact was like the sound of a war drum, vibrating every inch of his nerves, making it impossible for him to find any peace. He clenched his fists subconsciously, his knuckles turning white from exertion. The rough leather gloves in his palms seemed to be his only support at the moment, conveying an inexplicable strength and comfort.
At that moment, time seemed to freeze. Ye Heng's thoughts were spinning rapidly in his mind, and every thought was like a sharp arrow, looking for the best way out.
Ye Heng knew that the answer to this question was not only related to Ailu's life and death, but also affected the fate of all of them. He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and tried to find a crack of reason in this suffocating atmosphere.
The silence of just a few seconds seemed to be stretched infinitely in that small space, turning into an endless torment. Finally, after experiencing a silence that seemed as long as a century, Ye Heng exhaled, "We can't do this."
These words, like a thunder, exploded in the quiet space, making everyone's eardrums buzz.
"Sister Amy, Elu, we can't kill them."
When Amy heard this, she was slightly shaken, and a flash of surprise and confusion flashed in her eyes.
She stared at Ye Heng, trying to catch a clue from those deep eyes.
However, Ye Heng's eyes were like a deep and unpredictable pool of water, calm and calm, but making it impossible to touch the truth hidden under the water.
"Why?"
Amy finally couldn't help but speak.
Ye Heng did not answer immediately. He looked at Ai Lu, and then slowly looked at Amy, "Because she is our clue and the key to finding the truth. In addition, Ai Lu is an S-class traitor. If we can bring her back to the Martial God Kingdom, it will be a credit to our actions this time."
There was a decisive light in her eyes, which was a kind of wisdom and strategy. Amy stared at him, with a hint of surprise in her eyes, which was then replaced by deep understanding. She nodded gently, without saying anything, the admiration had quietly taken root in her eyes. She knew that the Ye Heng in front of her had transformed from the hesitant young man in the past, and had grown into a man with firm beliefs.
Amy nodded gently, her eyes flashing with understanding of Ye Heng's worries. They knew that this trip must be done step by step, and the slightest slack could lay the foundation for disaster.
Only in this way can Ai Lu's identity be skillfully used to weave an invisible protective net for her own safety. She nodded and understood Ye Heng's intention. So, in order to ensure nothing went wrong, Ye Heng slowly took out a glowing God-locking ring from the space ring, and skillfully slowly sealed the surging martial arts power in Ai Lu's body to eliminate potential threats.
With the thorny problem of Ellu properly solved, the road ahead is still full of unknown challenges and hidden dangers, but they are ready to move forward fearlessly.
Face the sun and gradually illuminate your headAt the top, a group of people quietly left Dragon Claw City. Their steps were firm and fast, as if there was an invisible force pushing them forward. Ye Heng walked at the front, and Ailu was sealed with martial arts power. Naturally, she was placed in the middle of the team, closely guarded by two team members. Even so, there was a trace of unwillingness and anger in her eyes, but she could not break free from the shackles of the God Lock Ring.
The team walked through the sun, and the surrounding scenery looked particularly mysterious and strange under the sunlight. They passed through dense forests, climbed over steep mountains, and finally arrived at Shenlong City, deeper in the Dragon Kingdom.
Shenlong City is a huge city, and the towering buildings look even more majestic under the sunlight.
However, there is a depressing and heavy atmosphere permeating the city, as if there are some unknown secrets hidden deep in the city.
Shenlong City is the capital of the Dragon Kingdom and a city that once stood at the top. Although the Dragon Kingdom previously ruled the entire planet, they loved humans very much and treated humans as if they were their own people.
In the center of Shenlong City, there is a huge building towering into the clouds, called the "Dragon Heart Tower"
The tower body is made of a kind of "star stone"
Built of rare materials, whenever night falls, the tower will emit a faint light, like a bright pearl embedded in the center of the city. Even though more than hundreds of years have passed, this high platform still stands in the center of the city. As if telling the greatness and mystery of the Dragon Kingdom, at this time, on the top floor of the Dragon Heart Tower, a middle-aged man in black robe was overlooking the entire city. His eyes were deep and sharp, as if he could penetrate all illusions and look directly at every corner of the city.
"This city was once the pride of our Dragon Kingdom."
The man whispered to himself, his voice full of nostalgia and emotion. He stretched out his hand and gently touched the star stone beside him. The cold touch made him fall into memories.
"I was once the pride of the Dragon Kingdom and the Divine Dragon Clan. It was because I was too weak and failed to defend the Dragon Kingdom, allowing the Demonic Dragon Clan to take advantage of the loophole. As a result, the Divine Dragon Clan suffered heavy losses and was destroyed due to the sudden arrival of supernatural beasts on the mainland..."
“This place was once a paradise on earth with beautiful mountains and clear waters. The winding river was crystal clear, like a silver ribbon, gently dancing among the green mountains.
The gurgling river water caresses the pebbles on the river bank, making a sweet sound, which seems to be telling ancient stories. "
“I still remember that there were so many mountains and mountains all around, and the trees were lush and green.
The birds in the mountains sing cheerfully, intertwining with the occasional sound of shepherd's flutes in the distance to form a beautiful musical picture. The air here carries the freshness and sweetness of nature, and every breath seems to wash away the dust in your heart. "
"However, time flies by; as time goes by, this beautiful land gradually changes and slowly disappears in the long river of time."
As the mysterious man finished speaking, he gently glanced at Ye Heng and the others. His deep gaze was like the stars in the night sky, shining with an elusive light. The corner of his mouth raised an imperceptible arc, as if he was mocking their ignorance and insignificance, and said slightly in his mouth: "Don't admit that I am disappointed."
